models.telemetry: actual completed-frame recent/average FPS; source FPS is labeled separately; job wall-clock includes preparation

table_policy.ball_detection: full-frame, no prepass and no table ROI gating
table_policy.precalibrate: explicit legacy search; failure warns, ball detection continues
table_policy.unknown_geometry: empty bounds, no invented out/net events
table_policy.camera_cuts: immutable per-frame snapshots; clear geometry, split temporal inputs/tracks/rallies

rally_rules.events: out_without_table_bounce, below_table_stopped, held_after_flight, net_drop_same_side; wait for serve or reciprocal play
rally_rules.perspective_activity: perspective-activity-v2: toss/reciprocal-motion qualification; local horizontal recovery cancels pending settling; end at observed confirmation, never backdate to slow-window start; not net/out adjudication
rally_rules.side_transit: side-transit-v4 (strong transit >=1.0 table widths/s): trusted side-view geometry only; episodes start at a fast low cross-table transit (optional end-of-table serve toss; a high and only moderately fast paddle return cannot open one; start = earlier of toss-0.2 s and first transit-1.3 s; a lone strong transit above 0.8 table heights is a return, not a serve fault), continue on further transits within 1.2 s (far player may be out of frame), end transit_gap; slow/high return lobs excluded; no audio; not net/out adjudication
rally_rules.frame_serve: frame-serve-v8: a toss-less episode with one ball run and no other motion (lone flight) is dropped; a high ball travelling >=0.4 W across is not a toss; no toss and the ball entered from the frame edge <=1.5 s before: not a serve; a frame-rule episode is one rally that the visual tail trim may not end before its last stroke; v7: the start moves back over a directly preceding chain of soft horizontal runs (>=0.08 W, >=0.11 S, gaps <=0.8 s) with >=1 direction reversal (soft serve / pushes before the first fast stroke; one-way carry does not count); a fast stroke within 0.5 s after a slow drift keeps the rally; a steep high ball within 0.8 s of in-play motion is not a new toss; v5: a >=1.0 s drift slower than 0.33 S after the strokes ends the rally (ball rolling / carried back); every non-side segment (perspective boxes included) when ball runs are mostly horizontal and >=40 runs calibrate S/W; perspective-activity-v2 only as fallback; serve-prep bounce burst (>=3 alternating short vertical runs) within 8 s before the serve on the server side starts the rally (start_reason=serve_prep); a lone jump between still balls is not a stroke; stroke_gap is not a net/out call; no audio
rally_rules.play_area: play-area-v1: tracks with no stroke whose median lies >0.2 L outside the local (+-45 s) 5-95% extent of stroke-track points get off_play=true; self-calibrated physical frame units, no table needed; display hint only, never dropped, not read by rally rules
rally_rules.limits: heuristic; side-view geometric dead-ball rules and optional perspective activity are distinct; net rules require trustworthy net geometry; reported 0043/0045 cases checked, not full accuracy acceptance

models.runtime: Python 3.12; torch 2.8.0; MPS preferred, CPU supported; weights_only=True and strict state_dict loading
models.input: 3 consecutive unique RGB frames, ImageNet normalization, aspect-preserving 512x288 affine resize

optimization_source.adapted: bounded decode/main-thread GPU/CPU postprocess pipeline, compact uint8 inputs, batch normalization, optional half precision
optimization_source.preserved: RGB affine preprocessing, source PTS, SHA-256 / weights_only safe loading, rally protocol and no automatic CPU/classical fallback on failure

models.training_data: Author-provided table-tennis / motion-blur checkpoint; see upstream paper and dataset. No private user video uploaded or used for training.
limitations: table ROI calibration still blue/purple-table based
final 1-2 frames are unscored if an incomplete temporal window remains

models.selection: explicit --detector classical-av-v1 for comparison; never automatic fallback
